requirements.text: The general admissions FAQ specifically identifies human factors as accepting varied undergraduate backgrounds. The 2026-27 Daytona MSHF criteria require knowledge of psychology and statistics, rather than a named bachelor's major, and allow assignment of undergraduate catch-up courses. For applicants whose primary language is not English, 2026-27 catalog minima include IELTS 6.0; TOEFL iBT 79 if taken before 21 January 2026 or 4 on the revised scale on/after that date; Duolingo 105; PTE Academic 59. Other listed tests: TOEFL Essentials 8.5, Cambridge 170, EIKEN Pre-1, LanguageCert Academic 65. Six postsecondary English Composition credits at C or above can evidence proficiency. Successful ERLI study plus director recommendation may permit an exam exemption; ERLI admission does not guarantee degree admission. No exemption is assumed.

Psychology and statistics prerequisite knowledge is required; no quantified credits, named cognition class, prior laboratory experience, programming, creative portfolio or minimum professional employment duration is specified in the inspected MSHF criteria. GMAT/GRE not required. Undergraduate prerequisites may be assigned; their credit count, completion timing and cost are individualized and not established. General conditional admission is discretionary, not a guaranteed bridge: the initial nine graduate credits require B or better in each course and CGPA 3.0. Standard supporting-document guidance discusses statement of objectives, resume, and academic/professional references; the public MSHF criteria do not give an unambiguous reference count. The campus landing page refers to three letters, so the exact MSHF checklist remains a verification gap. Foreign educational experience normally requires an official course-by-course evaluation in English including GPA and U.S. equivalence, with applicant-paid evaluation/translation costs. Duration and delivery: Daytona Beach in-person, 36 credits. Both thesis and non-thesis options count as this same endpoint. The current catalog supplies two-year plans with four fall/spring semesters at nine credits each; the department also describes the conventional master's as four semesters. A separate Worldwide online delivery exists with a different 30/33-credit structure; it is not counted as another endpoint here and its fees/admission rules are not substituted for Daytona rules. Award scope: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, College of Arts and Sciences, Department of Human Factors and Behavioral Neurobiology; Daytona Beach, Florida. Professional-recognition scope: The 2026-27 catalog identifies the Daytona MS as HFES-accredited. This is programme recognition; academic admission and completion do not automatically confer an engineering licence, psychology licence, professional certification, immigration permission or employment eligibility. Verification caveats: Do not import the 2.5 Worldwide GPA, online tuition, online credit count or faster generic duration into the Daytona endpoint. Do not apply the ERAU fast-track any-bachelor/3.5 rule to an external applicant; that is a distinct internal pathway, not the ordinary route. The undergraduate catch-up allowance is explicit, but the university has not specified this applicant's bridge. The programme-specific no-GRE policy controls over general pages saying tests are required for some degrees. The standard first-nine-graduate-credit conditional-performance rule is separate from assigned undergraduate prerequisites; custom conditional offers can impose individual terms. No automatic bridge, timing, visa availability or 2027 curriculum promise is inferred. Personal eligibility: Unassessed.
